name: Phoenix Coronet
description: The phoenix crown is a ceremonial crown made of metal mesh, decorated with emerald phoenixes, and hung with jewelry tassels. Its shape is extremely gorgeous, inlaid with pearls, gems, jade and other precious jewelry. It is beautiful, dazzling and extraordinary. It symbolizes auspiciousness, hope and happiness, carries people's good wishes for a happy marriage and a happy marriage for a hundred years, and is the lifelong expectation of many women. When a woman gets married, she wears a phoenix crown, Xia Pei, and red embroidered shoes. She is full of joy and welcomes the important moment of life with the most beautiful attitude.
